newsitem.title: UK: UK economy competitive despite stg rise-Major.
newsitem.headline: UK economy competitive despite stg rise-Major.

text.p: Britain's economy is more competitive than it has been in a long time despite sterling's recent rise, Prime Minister John Major said on Tuesday.
Speaking at a news conference devoted largely to education, Major described Britain's economic prospects as "sparklingly positive".
Major said Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke had succeeded in producing "the best economic circumstances we've seen in this country for a very long time indeed".

Inflation was low, growth was rising, unemployment was falling, exports were rising and Britain was enjoying "a degree of competitiveness, notwithstanding the recent rise in the exchange value of sterling against the deutschmark and some other currencies, on a scale we haven't seen sustained for a very long period of time".
